statement: Training-time interventions can change how well a model uses supplied context: position-agnostic decompositional training tasks improve long-context QA substantially (13.7% absolute gain in shuffled settings), which means the effect of added context depends on how the model was trained to use it.

evidence.quote: To overcome this crucial issue, this paper proposes to enhance the information searching and reflection ability of LLMs in long contexts via specially designed tasks called Attention Strengthening Multi-doc QA (ASM QA).
